hubDesc: Learn through interactive mini-games and earn coins! The more you learn, the more games you unlock.
lockedAlert: Complete previous games to unlock this one!

balloon-pop.title: Balloon Pop Catcher
balloon-pop.desc: Pop floating letter balloons in the correct order to spell vocabulary words.

trace-letters.title: Trace Master
trace-letters.desc: Practice writing native letters directly on screen with drawing accuracy check.

sound-match.title: Sound Matcher
sound-match.desc: Pair vocal sounds of the alphabet with their corresponding written scripts.

fruit-catch.title: Fruit Catcher
fruit-catch.desc: Catch the correct falling translation objects in your basket under speed pressure.

pic-bingo.title: Picture Bingo
pic-bingo.desc: Match spoken vocabulary words to the correct image on a 3x3 grid to get Bingo!

memory-flip.title: Flash Memory Flip
memory-flip.desc: Flip cards to match the written vocabulary word to its corresponding image and sound.

sentence-builder.title: Sentence Scrambler
sentence-builder.desc: Arrange scrambled words to construct grammatically sound sentences.

sign-reader.title: Speed Sign Reader
sign-reader.desc: Rapidly identify the meaning of public, travel, and safety street signs.

shop-keeper.title: Bazaar Shopkeeper
shop-keeper.desc: Fulfill customer orders, measure products, and calculate bills correctly.

crossword-clue.title: Clue Crossword
crossword-clue.desc: Solve intermediate crossword puzzles with local word definitions and clues.

tense-shift.title: Tense Shift Connect
tense-shift.desc: Connect verbs to their appropriate past, present, or future tense forms under a matching timer.

dialogue-puzzler.title: Dialogue Puzzler
dialogue-puzzler.desc: Re-arrange conversational bubbles to form a coherent, polite dialogue.

word-sprint.title: Word Sprint Typer
word-sprint.desc: Type out correct phonetic translations before they crash into the screen edge.

echo-chamber.title: Echo Tongue Twisters
echo-chamber.desc: Record tongue twisters and complex phrases to test pronunciation rhythm.

text-detective.title: Grammar Detective
text-detective.desc: Spot and fix spelling/syntax errors hidden within news briefs or mock emails.

speed-editor.title: Editorial Speed Draft
speed-editor.desc: Race against the clock to replace formal words with their high-register synonyms.

debate-builder.title: Debate Argument Builder
debate-builder.desc: Select logical evidence blocks and counter-arguments to win an AI speech debate.

idiom-connect.title: Idiom Connect
idiom-connect.desc: Connect sophisticated cultural idioms with their abstract real-world explanations.
